reason: Z.ai serves GLM (z-ai/glm-5.3-flash, the operator's main model) with automatic tool selection only, so chat's routing tool_choice=required is advisory there and GLM often answers a question in plain text with finish_reason stop and no tool call or finish_response. Since #487 that no longer fails the turn, but the routing step broke to the separate tool-free synthesis request, which threw GLM's answer away, paid for a second full-context call and recorded the chat.routing.prose_with_required_tool warning on every such turn. opencode, Codex, the Vercel AI SDK, Cline and pi-mono all end the loop on a response with no tool calls and use its text as the answer. The routing step now does the same when the reply has no calls, ended normally (stop, end_turn, stop_sequence, completed or no reason), carries no DSML markup Core could not read and passes _final_answer_problem: the text is streamed as the answer and the turn is persisted and completed the way the synthesis completes it (_completion, _persist, naming, COMPLETE with the turn usage, done), with a debug trace instead of the warning, and the chat.turn.completed hook runs once before the answer is persisted, as #494 made the synthesis do. Text cut off by the output limit, ending for a tool call it does not carry, a control frame (whole or trailing) and a reasoning-only or empty reply still go to synthesis, and prose beside tool calls is unchanged. The answer is checked before the goal guard, so a goal budget the answering reply spent completes the turn with its answer, as a synthesis that spent it would, instead of failing it. tests/v3/test_routing_prose_answer.py drives a real OpenRouter provider over a mock transport: the first-step answer, the answer after a tool step, the goal case and the completed-hook case fail on main (a second, synthesis request is made, or the turn fails); the synthesis-fallback cases pass on both and pin that the fallback is kept. test_routing_prose_without_a_call_finishes_through_synthesis from #487 is rewritten as test_routing_prose_without_a_call_is_the_answer. The other selected node ids exercise the routing branches next to the change.
